facts.text: The Swarm system prompt text lives in `prompts/swarm-system-prompt.md`, the single editable source. `assembleForgePrompt` in `extensions/swarm-prompt/extension.ts` builds the prompt from its sections, resolving `{{placeholder}}` sections (workspace, headless-base, user, tools, skills, restrictions) through producers and throwing if a placeholder has no producer.

The `testing-contract` section of `prompts/swarm-system-prompt.md` forbids writing unit tests and requires end-to-end user-visible verification only. It is exported as `TESTING_CONTRACT` from `extensions/swarm-prompt/extension.ts`.

`ask_user_question` takes a required top-level `questions` array (schema in `extensions/ask-user/src/schema.ts`). The guidance in `extensions/ask-user/src/ask-tool-helpers.ts` asks for a stable `id` and non-empty `prompt` per question and a `value` and `label` per option.

Installing a normal Pi extension does not make Tern the default frontend for bare `pi`. Pi's CLI mode branch and `InteractiveMode` start the TUI before extension binding, so an extension-only startup hook cannot select the frontend.
evidence: docs/reference/pi-tern-extension-default-blocker.md#Why a Pi extension alone cannot select TSP at startup

facts.text: Tern plugins are folders whose `plugin.toml` names `host.luau` and `window.luau` as their two halves, as in `tern-plugins/code-puppy/plugin.toml`. The stencil-hq SDK repo and `plugins/tern.d.luau` are not verified in this repository.

The TaskManage task completion contract in `extensions/taskmanage/extension.ts` requires evidence as `tool:<ToolName>` or `tool:<ToolName>#<n>`, where `<n>` is the 1-based chronological result of that tool in the session. The rejection of unregistered names like `tool:mcp__Bash#1` is not verified in the repository.
